summary: Owncast is a self-hosted live-streaming server (Go + sqlc + SQLite). Admin configures via /api/admin/* (Basic Auth admin/<bcrypt password> stored in datastore) and chat/social/federation features all persist in one SQLite DB via sqlc queries and raw-SQL repositories. Mined schemas cover the chat backlog, users + access tokens + linked auth identities, the config key/value store, webhooks, browser-push notifications, IP bans, and the ActivityPub federation layer (followers, outbox, accepted activities, durable delivery queue, federated servers).
